!C-SCSAW7-10  # D7 is not in the slit type table (D 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 16, 20, 25, 30)
!C-SCSAW6-15  # width 15 is not offered for D6 (B 8 or 10)
!C-SCNPAW6-10  # the split type is offered for D6 only in width 8 (p.544)
!C-SCSMAW6-8  # the 2 through fixing holes type starts at D8 (p.545)
!C-SCSGAW10-8  # D10 counterbored is offered in B 10 and 12, not 8 (p.545)
!C-SCSAW12  # the width is missing: <type><D>-<B>
!C-SCSBNAW12-10  # the bearing inner mount collar is ordered with its selection Ds (D12 -> Ds16), not a width (p.546)
!C-SCSBNAW7-9  # D7 is not in the bearing inner mount table (D 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30)
!E-SCSPD7  # D7 is not in the compact split table (D 6, 8, 10, 12, 13, 15, 16, 20, 25, 30)
!E-SSCSPD6  # stainless steel compact split is only available for D 15, 16, 20 and 25 (p.546 note)
!E-SCSPD6-10  # the compact split type has no width suffix
!E-SCD4  # for D4 only the electroless nickel plated E-PSCD4 is available (p.547 note)
!E-SSCD13  # stainless steel standard slit is only available for the * marked D (p.547)
!E-SCD45  # D45 is not in the standard slit table (D 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 13, 15, 16, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50)
!E-SCDJ12  # the compact slit type needs the width selection B: E-SCDJ12-10
!E-SCDJ12-12  # D12 compact slit is offered in B 10 only (p.547 B selection)
!E-SSCDJ25-15  # D25 compact slit is not available in stainless steel (p.547 note)
!E-XSCD12  # not a MISUMI type prefix (E-SCD, E-PSCD, E-SSCD)
